jobs.occupation: Senior Accountant - International and Dynamic Environment
jobs.description:
Company Presentation

We are recruiting on behalf of a fast-growing company operating in the service sector linked to healthcare, located in the Brussels region.

This human-sized structure operates in a dynamic and modern environment, where innovation and service quality play a central role. The team, made up of around ten employees, works in a professional yet friendly atmosphere, with an accessible management style focused on collaboration.

The company stands out for its financial stability, continuous growth, and a corporate culture built on trust, autonomy, and teamwork. Internal initiatives and strong cohesion between departments contribute to a pleasant and motivating working environment.

Missions / Responsibilities

• Oversee the full accounting scope, both general and analytical, across multiple entities, ensuring accuracy and compliance of financial data.
• Record and follow up on day-to-day transactions (purchase and sales invoices, financial operations, and various accounting entries).
• Prepare and submit VAT returns, ensuring full compliance with Belgian tax regulations.
• Actively participate in monthly and annual closings, including period-end entries and cut-off operations.
• Perform bank reconciliations and ensure proper monitoring of customer and supplier balances.
• Carry out account reconciliations and ensure consistency of accounting records.
• Contribute to financial reporting and the preparation of dashboards for management.
• Participate in the continuous improvement and optimisation of accounting processes and internal tools.
• Collaborate with internal teams and, when necessary, with external partners (accounting firms, auditors, etc.).

Profile Required

• Education Degree in accounting, finance, or equivalent through experience.
• Experience Minimum 5 years of experience in general accounting, ideally in a multi-entity or international environment.
• Technical skills Strong command of accounting tools and Excel. Good knowledge of accounting closings and Belgian tax obligations. ERP knowledge is an asset.
• Languages Fluent in French and strong professional level of English, both written and spoken.
• Personal qualities Rigorous, autonomous, analytical mindset, and strong team spirit. You are also proactive and solution-oriented.

The employer is a dynamic and growing organisation operating within a modern commercial and operational environment. Bringing together various services, activities and partners on one site, the company relies on strong internal coordination to ensure smooth day-to-day functioning. To support this mission, it is looking for an Office Manager who will play a key role in the operational and administrative management of the location.

Jobomschrijving

The Office Manager acts as a central point of coordination for the Technical Director and supports various operational teams across the shopping centre.Administrative Management She/he manages internal and external communications, prepares and reviews documents, maintains updated tenant information, circulates weekly footfall data to the Landlord, the Property Manager and the internal team, and organises meetings and conferences. She/he also manages agendas, appointments and administrative workflows.Coordination She/he collaborates closely with internal departments, external partners and tenants to ensure fluid communication and the smooth running of ongoing projects. Responsibilities include drafting meeting minutes, monitoring deadlines, managing office supplies, and overseeing the Info Desk schedule, orders and administrative tasks, including basic support with SUMUP-related matters.Reception & Customer Relations As a representative of the shopping centre, she/he welcomes visitors, partners and clients in a warm and professional manner and provides clear, accurate information regarding the centre's services and activities.Information Management She/he maintains all records, files and databases, ensures confidentiality and data security, oversees the publication and updates of House Rules on Chainels and manages internal communication such as "What's Up" on Chainels.Support to Management She/he assists the Facility Manager with follow-up on files such as security and insurance, prepares ad hoc reports and summaries to support decision-making and provides occasional support to the marketing team when needed.

The ideal candidate demonstrates professionalism, discretion and strong organisational abilities.Key criteria include:

• A flexible and hands-on approach.
• A degree in Business Administration, Secretarial Studies or a related field.
• Previous experience in an Executive Assistant, Office Manager or similar role; experience in a shopping-centre environment is a strong asset.
• Excellent organisational, prioritisation and time-management skills.
• Strong proficiency in MS Office and digital tools.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work autonomously, anticipate needs and take initiative.
• High level of discretion and a proactive mindset.
• Fluency in French, Dutch and English.

Our client based in Nivelles is an international and fast-growing company operating in the logistics and supply chain sector. Are you ready for a new challenge where your expertise can truly make a difference?

As an Operations Expert, you'll play a key role in manufacturing advanced cell therapies that are transforming cancer treatment and giving patients new hope.

• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
 
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
 
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
 
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste. 

Who we are looking for:
 

 
• You have obtained at least a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
 
• Cell experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
 
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
 
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
 
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
 
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

jobs.occupation: IT Support Technician – L1 Resident Engineer (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
As L1 Resident Engineer, you are the first point of contact for all IT incidents and requests on site. You combine deskside support and helpdesk. 

User support
  
• Provide Level 1 IT support, on site and remotely, to employees at the Liège site 
• Diagnose and resolve common incidents: laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, printers, headsets and peripherals 
• Support Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365 environments (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive), as well as basic application support 
• Resolve basic connectivity issues (LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN) 
• Support meeting rooms and videoconferencing equipment (Teams, cameras, microphones, screens)  
Access and security
  
• Manage access: accounts, password resets, MFA and authentication, in line with security procedures 
• Apply IT security policies and immediately report any suspicious incident (phishing, malware, unauthorised access)  
Hardware and lifecycle
  
• Install, configure and prepare IT equipment (PCs, iOS/Android mobile devices, peripherals) 
• Handle IT onboarding and offboarding of employees (workstation preparation, handover and collection of equipment, access rights) 
• Keep the IT inventory up to date and coordinate replacements, warranties, repairs and disposals 
• Tickets, escalation and coordination 
• Log, prioritise, track and close tickets in the ITSM tool (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management…) 
• Escalate complex incidents to L2/L3 teams with a full diagnosis, and follow them up in line with SLAs 
• Act as the link with central IT teams, service providers and external suppliers 
• Inform local management of major incidents or service interruptions 
• Contribute to IT documentation (knowledge base, procedures, troubleshooting guides)  
You are not just a ticket-taker: you are the local IT point of reference and help ensure the continuity of the site's IT services.
 
THE TEAM & THE MANAGER
 
Based at the Liège office, you report directly to the Station Manager, Pierre Jeurissen. You work closely with SAL International's IT teams in Belgium and Saudi Arabia.

Essential 
 
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent technical qualification in IT 
• At least 2 years' experience in helpdesk, service desk, desktop support or field support 
• Fluent French and English, both spoken and written 
• Strong command of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365; basic knowledge of Active Directory / Entra ID (Azure AD) and MFA 
• Basic knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) and cybersecurity  
Assets
  
• Knowledge of Arabic 
• Experience as a Resident Engineer / Onsite Support Engineer 
• Experience in the aviation or logistics sector, in an international environment 
• IT certifications (CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, Microsoft…)  
Soft skills
  
• Customer focus and service mindset 
• Autonomy and rigour in incident management 
• Clear communication with non-technical users 
• Hands-on, proactive attitude

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. The company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

Currently in a phase of significant growth, they are looking for motivated and dedicated team members to join their mission.

Jobomschrijving

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

Are you a (recent) graduate with a bachelor’s degree in biotechnology, chemistry, agro- or life sciences? Are you ready to put your knowledge and skills into practice in a setting where innovation meets purpose?

We’re looking for ambitious, detail-oriented professionals to help shape the future of medicine. At our leading biotech company, you won’t just find a job you’ll begin a meaningful, long-term career in advanced biomanufacturing.

Your journey starts with comprehensive training, where you’ll learn the fundamentals of aseptic (germ-free) techniques and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice), the key standards that guide our industry. You’ll quickly gain confidence with the tools, procedures, and mindset that define high-quality biotech production.

After onboarding, you’ll join our dynamic Operations team, working hands-on with cutting-edge technologies and sterile processes. Together with your colleagues, you’ll perform precise manual and aseptic production steps, always following clear protocols to guarantee patient safety and product quality.

What your day-to-day will look like:

• Contributing to aseptic and manual production processes
• Working in a cleanroom laboratory environment
• Performing production steps in controlled areas (grade A/B/C/D), such as spiking, media changes, cell culture, and freezing therapeutic products
• Managing equipment, including inspections and maintenance
• Thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials
• Supporting transitions between production zones
• Ensuring patients receive high-quality therapies on time

• You’re eager to apply your scientific background and contribute to something meaningful, making a real difference in the lives of patients.
• You’re energized by dynamic environments and excited to keep learning and growing within advanced biomanufacturing.
• You hold a bachelor’s degree in biotechnology, chemistry, agro- or life sciences, and you’re ready to take the next step from the classroom to cutting-edge industry.
• You value structure and precision, and you feel comfortable working in a sterile (aseptic) setting, wearing the proper cleanroom gear.
• High-tech equipment and innovative processes spark your curiosity, you want to be part of what’s next.
• You communicate clearly in English, both written and spoken.
• You’re a real team player with a strong eye for detail, and you understand the importance of following procedures carefully.
• You’re flexible and open to working in shifts.
• You’re excited about a 4-days-on, 4-days-off schedule that supports both focus and work-life balance.
